Locality

Palghar West vs Palghar East: Which Side Should You Buy On?

Palghar West is the established side: the town core, the market, civic offices, most older schools and hospitals, and the Devisha Road and Vajali Pada apartment belt. Palghar East - Vevoor, Station Road and the belt toward Boisar - has more available land, more new launches, more plotted development and generally lower per-square-foot pricing. West suits buyers who want everything walkable; East suits buyers who want space, plots, or an entry price.

Updated 2026-09-02 · Written by Om Shanti N R Construction, Palghar

The two sides at a glance

Palghar West Palghar East
Key localitiesDevisha Road, Vajali Pada, Juna Palghar, AmbawadiVevoor, Station Road, the Boisar-side belt, Tembhode
CharacterEstablished town core with civic and commercial densityNewer development with more open land
Typical stock1, 2 and 3 BHK apartments; mixed-use and commercial1 and 2 BHK apartments; NA plots and plotted layouts
Social infrastructureSchools, hospitals, banks and the market already in placeGrowing; still partly dependent on the West

What Palghar West gives you

West is where the town actually functions. The market, the older residential colonies, a cluster of schools and hospitals, and the administrative offices that came with district headquarters status are all on this side.

For an end-user, the practical benefit is that daily life does not require a vehicle. Station, market, school, bank and clinic are within a short radius of most of the residential belt.

The trade-off is density and price. Plots are scarce, buildings are closer together, and the same budget buys less carpet area than it would across the tracks.

What Palghar East gives you

East has land. That is the whole difference. It is where new apartment complexes and plotted layouts are being launched, and where the belt running toward Boisar picks up the industrial and infrastructure activity of the wider district.

For a buyer, that translates into more choice, larger layouts, and pricing that is generally lower per square foot than the West for comparable specification.

The trade-off is that social infrastructure is still filling in. Some daily needs still route back across to the West, and how convenient a specific East address feels depends heavily on where it sits relative to Station Road.

Does the station divide matter for resale?

Less than buyers expect. In a town the size of Palghar, both sides are within a few minutes of the same station, and resale demand is driven more by the specific building, its age, its occupation certificate status and its distance from the station than by the compass direction.

What does affect resale is legal cleanliness. A flat with a clear title, an occupation certificate and a promoter who is still contactable resells far more easily on either side than one without.

A practical way to choose

  • Decide first whether you want a flat or a plot. Plots are overwhelmingly an East and outer-belt proposition.
  • Measure the actual walk or drive from the specific project to the station and the market, in minutes, at the time of day you would do it.
  • Compare on carpet area, not saleable area, across both sides.
  • Check the MahaRERA record for each shortlisted project before comparing prices.
  • Visit on a weekday and a Sunday. Palghar's traffic and market density read very differently on the two.

Frequently asked questions

Is Palghar West better than Palghar East?

Neither is better in general. Palghar West is denser and better serviced, with the market, civic offices and most established schools and hospitals. Palghar East has more land, more new launches, plotted development and generally lower per-square-foot pricing. The right side depends on whether you want walkable town life or space and entry pricing.

Which localities are in Palghar West?

Devisha Road, Vajali Pada, Juna Palghar and the Ambawadi belt, along with the older town core around the market and the civic offices.

Which localities are in Palghar East?

Vevoor, the Station Road belt, Tembhode and the corridor running toward Boisar.

Where can you buy plots in Palghar?

Plotted development is concentrated in the eastern and outer belts of the taluka, including Tembhode, Vevoor and the roads toward Boisar and Satpati. Plotted schemes require MahaRERA registration.
